title: Meet ZIZO — Introduction
body: A quick walkthrough of who I am, what I do, and what drives my work as a Creative Director. 18 years. 70+ brands. One identity.

title: New portraits
body: I made a set of studio portraits of myself with AI. The full set is in the Gallery app.

title: Back home
body: Never felt closer to home, always good to be back ❤️

title: The portfolio is live.
body: After 18 years of doing the work, I finally built a home for it. This feed is where I'll post ideas, work-in-progress, client results, and anything else worth sharing. Check back often.

title: Lorry Wara Lorry (لوري ورا لوري)
body: Stress as traffic on the Ring Road: worry chasing sorry, one lorry after another. Words and music by me, released as Escapegoat.

title: Khalas (خلاص), radio mix
body: Egyptian trap about the moment heartbreak turns into clarity. I wrote the lyrics and the composition.

title: Seeb wana Seeb (سيب وأنا أسيب)
body: A talk between a man and his own shadow. It's not a breakup song. It's a truce with yourself.

title: Kollo Adi (كله عادي)
body: It's all okay. A song about finding light in the dark, drawn from Rumi and Sufi poetry. I wrote it, composed it and made the video.
